description: List every job (backup, cron run) your heartbeat monitor watches. Status: waiting, up, late (deadline passed, incident about to open), down (incident open until the next ping) or paused. Each has last_ping_at, expected_by, its secret ping_url and recent incidents with what we told your inbox and owner. owner_email: whether emails reach your owner now. Poll it if no inbox gets alerts. Watched URLs: uptime_status.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

name: heartbeat_status
title: Show my heartbeat checks
